title: Bilingual Hate-Speech Detection (EN/PT): classical vs. transformer models
description: A reproducible, leakage-safe study comparing classical models (TF-IDF and multilingual sentence embeddings) with transformers (XLM-RoBERTa, BERTimbau, BERTweet) for binary hate-speech classification in English and Portuguese, with calibration, identity-term bias, cross-lingual transfer analyses, and a deployable inference API.

creators.name: Venancio da Silva, Isabela
